title: John Metchie III 2022 Select CONCOURSE BLUE Rookie RC #9 HOUSTON Texans Alabama
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Introducing a 2022 Select John Metchie III Rookie RC #9 Trading Card from the Houston Texans. This card features the talented football player from Alabama, John Metchie III, who is sure to make a name for himself in the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) and National Football League (NFL). The card is part of the 2022 Select set and is manufactured by Select. 

The card comes in a beautiful blue parallel/variety and features Metchie's rookie season with the Houston Texans. It is a must-have for any sports trading card collector who loves football. The card is not autographed, but it still holds a lot of value. Get your hands on this amazing card and add it to your collection today!
